dialogue.chat: There you are! I was JUST telling the kettle we were due a proper talk, %1$s. Come in, come in.
dialogue.chat/1: A chat? You've made my whole afternoon. Sit — how are you, really?
dialogue.chat/2: Always time for you! What's on your heart today?
dialogue.conversations: I was hoping you'd stop by! Pull up a chair, %1$s — there's bread if you want it. What's on your mind?
dialogue.conversations/1: Of course we can talk — I could go all day! Where shall we start?
dialogue.conversations/2: You never have to ask twice with me. Sit, sit!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: So good, honestly! The oven's been kind, the neighbors kinder, and now you're here. Full week!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/1: Really good, and better for your face at the door, %1$s. You brighten a room.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good/2: Lovely week, lovelier now. No complaints — and I'd share them if I had any!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: A heavy stretch, truth be told. But you asking? That warms me like fresh bread, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough/1: A bit heavy, if I'm honest. Come sit — talking with you already helps.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again: You already asked, you sweet thing! Still fine, still glad you care enough to check twice.
dialogue.conversations.checkin.again/1: Twice in a day? You spoil me, %1$s. Same answer, twice the smile.
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Lovely day! Traded eggs for honey at the well, and everyone had a minute to chat. My favorite kind.
dialogue.conversations.day.good/1: Grand! Waved to half the village and every one waved back. That's a good day, that.
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: A stumbly one — burnt the porridge, tripped over the cat. Nothing warm supper and good company won't mend!
dialogue.conversations.day.rough/1: Not my easiest, but a friendly face mends most things. Perfect timing, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.work.like: I do! You see everybody's faces, hear the news, share a laugh. The work's mostly the excuse, really.
dialogue.conversations.work.like/1: Very much! Every customer's a visit waiting to happen. I'd do it for the company alone.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Between friends? Not much. But the folk I do it alongside make it worth showing up. That's the trick.
dialogue.conversations.work.hate/1: Only the lonely stretches, when nobody comes by. I mind the quiet more than the work.
dialogue.conversations.village.home: %2$s? Oh, I love it here. Everyone knows everyone, and that suits me right to the ground.
dialogue.conversations.village.home/1: %2$s is one big family, %1$s. I know every name and most of the birthdays!
dialogue.conversations.people.first: I adore them, every one. Even the prickly ones have a soft middle, with patience and cake.
dialogue.conversations.people.first/1: The best neighbors in the world. We look after each other — that's the whole point of a village.
dialogue.conversations.food.first: Anything shared! A meal's better with company. Bring your appetite, I'll bring the butter.
dialogue.conversations.food.first/1: The inn's stew, at a full table. Food tastes better among laughing folk, don't you think?
dialogue.conversations.life.first: Nobody's asked in ages! Get comfortable — it's a long one, with three good harvests and a lot of shared suppers in it.
dialogue.conversations.life.first/1: A warm sort of story, full of neighbors and open doors. I remember every one fondly.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: A table long enough for the whole village. Everybody fed, nobody hurrying. You'd have a seat, of course.
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first/1: A house where nobody ever eats alone. That's the whole dream, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: Honestly? An empty chair at supper. Folks drifting off one by one till it's just me and the kettle.
dialogue.conversations.fears.first/1: That someone here is hurting and I didn't notice. I'd never forgive myself.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: Oh, you're family already, %1$s — didn't you know? The door's never locked for you.
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first/1: The day's always brighter with you in it. I've thought so a good while now.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: Ah, that's kitchen-table talk, and we're still at the front gate! Come by more — the kettle's always on.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal/: I'll tell you anything once we're proper friends — and we're nearly there!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: That's a story for old friends by a low fire, %1$s. We're getting there. Keep coming around, I mean it.
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate/: Ask me when you've a key to my kitchen. We're close — not quite THAT close yet.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Quiet week! Everyone's fine, fed, and boring — which is the best news a village can have, honestly.
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none/1: Not a peep! Come back tomorrow — someone always does something worth telling.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes: Happy? You're the best thing that ever walked through my door. Every single day, yes.
dialogue.conversations.us.happy.yes/1: The luckiest soul in the village, and it's your fault entirely. Yes, love. Yes.
